# ISSUE-nnn — Title

**Severity:** S1–S4 · **Found in:** x.y.z · **State:** Open · **Filed by:** <role/human> · **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD · **Epic:** EPIC-xxx or — · **Story:** STORY-xxx-nn or — · **Routed to:** (filled by Tech Lead)

## Observed
What happened, where (match, screen, command), exact output or symptom. Attach log excerpt / request_id.

## Expected
What the PRD / SA / story says should happen, with section reference.

## Reproduction
Numbered steps a stranger can follow. Recording file if one exists.

## Diagnosis (required before any fix)
- **Exact cause:** file:line, with the evidence
- **Blast radius:** downstream consumers, sibling modules, other epics affected
- **Why it was missed:** test gap, doc gap, assumption

## Resolution
What changed (commits, story), or why it was closed without change.

## Verification
| # | Given | When | Then | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Change log
| Date | Version | Author | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
